title: Shopping is moving to AI agents while PC costs rise; our store must adapt
summary: Walmart put Black Friday deals in Meta’s Muse agent; ChatGPT Wallet and Adyen/Klarna enable agent checkout; NRF: half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI. DigiTimes: PCB shortage to mid-2028, weak notebooks to Q2 2027.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a live deal-discovery and checkout channel
points.detail: Walmart added Black Friday deals to Meta’s Muse and ChatGPT Wallet enables merchant purchases. We should make our catalog, promos and checkout readable and usable by agents.

points.headline: Half of holiday shoppers plan to use AI for research
points.detail: NRF finds half plan to use AI this season, so our product pages and feeds need to be clear to AI assistants as well as to people.

points.headline: Component costs keep PC prices up while unit demand stays soft
points.detail: PCB shortages may last to mid-2028, notebook shipments stay weak through Q2 2027, and Best Buy computing sales held. We should plan inventory, pricing and mix carefully.

points.headline: Small-business holiday spending is at a 14-year high
points.detail: Amex projects the strongest small-business holiday spending in 14 years, a window for business bundles, financing and bulk offers in our store.
